shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
single anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
head/headgear at top with body extending below
incised linear detail (folds/bands) across the lower body
justification: Both are stone monuments dominated by a single upright anthropomorphic figure whose head with an elaborated/crown-like top sits above a body covered in incised linear detail, and both include small circular motifs. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a finely modelled profile figure with naturalistic drapery, hands, spear and bow rendered by a skilled relief carver on a flat slab, whereas B is a blocky frontal three-dimensional boulder with crude, schematic shallow incisions and no articulated limbs or attributes.
